jobs.title: Director, Test Solutions Engineering Manager (West Coast Region)
jobs.description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell is expanding its global Test Solutions Engineering (TSE) organization and seeking an experienced Manager to establish, staff, and lead a new TSE team in the Santa Clara US region.

The TSE organization owns ATE based production test development and plays a critical role in optimizing cost, quality, and NPI execution for Marvell’s custom data center silicon. This role has both organizational leadership responsibilities and deep technical ownership across new product introduction and high volume manufacturing readiness.

You will be responsible for building the regional team, developing talent, driving execution, and partnering globally to support rapid production ramps for hyperscale customers.

What You Can Expect

Team Building & Organizational Leadership

Build and scale the West Coast Test Solutions Engineering team, including hiring, onboarding, and developing engineering talent.
Establish team structure, follow existing workflows, and technical best practices to support global TSE operations.
Provide coaching, mentorship, performance management, and long‑term career development for the team.
Foster a collaborative, high‑execution culture across regional and global teams.

Program & Technical Leadership

Lead end‑to‑end New Product Introduction (NPI) for assigned programs, from design start through production ramp.
Own test strategy definition, architecture, and overall solution readiness for high‑volume manufacturing.
Drive silicon bring‑up, debug, and characterization to validate production test coverage and performance.
Ensure test solutions meet product requirements for quality, cost, and schedule.

Customer & Cross‑Functional Engagement

Serve as the primary technical and managerial interface to customers for test strategy alignment and issue resolution.
Partner closely with design, DFT, product and test engineering, manufacturing operations, and quality teams across multiple regions.

Quality, Reliability & Sustaining Engineering

Support reliability qualifications, stress testing, and customer return analysis.
Lead root‑cause analysis and drive corrective actions across engineering and manufacturing teams.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives across test processes, yield, and test cost.

Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
10-15 years of experience in Custom processor / ASIC Product Engineering, Test Engineering, DFT, or Technology Characterization.
Demonstrated success managing or leading engineering teams, preferably across geographies.
Strong understanding of:
Product Engineering and Test Development
Design‑for‑Test (DFT)
Semiconductor devices and process technology
Quality and reliability practices

Proven ability to lead complex technical programs and drive cross‑functional alignment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s or PhD in EE/CS (experience level dependent).
Experience hiring and building new teams or leading organizational expansion.
Experience supporting hyperscale or large enterprise customers.
Experience working with global or distributed engineering teams.

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

185,390 - 277,700, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

This role is eligible to participate in Marvell's bonus and equity plans, including a new hire equity grant and annual equity refreshers, ensuring you are rewarded for your contributions and remain invested in the company's long-term success.

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

Interview Integrity

To support fair and authentic hiring practices, candidates are not permitted to use AI tools (such as transcription apps, real-time answer generators like ChatGPT or Copilot, or automated note-taking bots) during interviews.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

This position may require access to technology and/or software subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. Except for U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), all applicants may be subject to an export license review process prior to employment.

jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst
, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

Some of the Problems You'll Solve:

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

How You'll Make an Impact:

📊 Build confidence in business decisions by designing analyses and communicating insights that help teams understand what is working – and what isn't.

📈 Turn data into strategic direction by uncovering trends, identifying opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations.

📉 Create visibility into organizational performance through dashboards, reporting, and metrics that stakeholders rely on every day.

🤝 Partner with cross-functional teams to frame business problems, evaluate options, and ensure decisions are supported by data.

🎯 Develop meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that enable teams to consistently measure success and track progress over time.

🔍 Identify opportunities to improve business processes, customer experiences, and operational efficiency through thoughtful analysis.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:

🧩 Use data to drive decisions.

You have a track record of solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and influencing decisions with data.

📊 Have strong analytical fundamentals.

SQL is a core part of your toolkit, and you're comfortable working with large datasets to uncover meaningful insights.

📈 Think beyond reporting.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

💬 Communicate with clarity.

You can explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and help stakeholders make informed decisions.

🤝 Enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

You're comfortable starting with a business question—not a predefined report—and determining what data, analyses, or metrics are needed to answer it.

🔄 Adapt quickly to new tools and technologies.

You enjoy learning new platforms and approaches and focus on solving problems rather than relying on a specific technology stack.

🛠 Bring experience with modern analytics tools.

Experience with SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms is a plus, but not required. Great analysts learn new tools. Great critical thinking is harder to teach.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

assured.claims
email addresses and all interviews are conducted through verified company channels. If you are unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly at recruiting-ops@assured.claims before sharing any personal information
**

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. jobs.title: Team Hornet Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Salary Range: $73,160 - $92,500

The F-18 Integrated Product Team (IPT) at NAWCWD China Lake has an opening for a Data Analyst (DA). The team member will be working in a dynamic environment and will be responsible for analyzing data, creating analysis tools, and reporting test results of F/A-18 C/D integration testing.

Essential Job Functions

System Engineering functions:

The DA will support technical engineering reviews, understand system requirements, learn the technical details of the F/A-18 C/D Integration effort, and apply that knowledge to help execute a dynamic test program.

Review system level documentation and provide changes and recommendations.

Interface with other government agencies and work with contractors on acquisition programs to assure that the Navy's interests are met.

Test Planning And Execution Functions

Actively participate in test planning of ground, laboratory, and flight test events to ensure decision quality test data is collected.

Develop test support, instrumentation, and data recording requirements to facilitate collection of critical flight test data.

Develop requirements for test scenarios and associated documentation in flight cards and lab test procedures.

Develop test methods for evaluating performance and designs test scenario(s) to yield valid and measurable quantitative test results.

Participate in pre- and post-test briefings and advise on system troubleshooting and behavior.

Assess and resolve engineering issues real time during test missions.

Participate in lab testing.

Perform tests using emulators and simulators and support the integration of multiple emulators and simulators.

Data Analysis Functions

Design data analysis processes to assess the performance of various systems and system concepts over development cycles.

Perform timely and accurate analysis to support decision authorities. The ideal candidate will have analysis experience in aircraft 1553 Mux, and MIDS, as well as the adaptability to quickly learn how to analyze other data types.

Develop data analysis tools to streamline and automate data analysis, processing, and reporting, to include handling large data sets.

Analyzes test data (real-time and post-mission) to understand test results, draw conclusions and assess mission results.

Communicate test results verbally and in writing to technical and non-technical audiences.

Leverage analytical studies to evaluate and advise on system architecture or potential alternative solutions.

Report systems performance in official Navy T&E reports.

Travel may be desired of the incumbent but is not a requirement for this position.

Required Skills

Due to the sensitivity of customer related requirements, U.S. Citizenship is required.

Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline with 5+ years of experience in flight test and/or Aircraft Platforms and Weapons. Will also consider candidates with high school diploma and 13+ years of experience in flight test and/or Aircraft Platforms and Weapons or an associate degree with 7+ years of experience in flight test and/or Aircraft Platforms and Weapons.

The ability to obtain and maintain a secret clearance throughout the duration of employment.

Ability to acquire and obtain Top Secret Clearance.

Ability to work with legacy avionics systems, to include understanding of assembly code.

Excellent communication skills and ability to liaison with outside agencies and to work independently.

Must demonstrate an ability to analyze and interpret multiple technical data sets, and organize/present data into tables, charts, graphs to support program requirements.

Ability to learn how to use multiple data analysis tools and software packages for data reduction and display.

Experience with coding in compiled and scripting languages (MatLab, Python, C#, etc.) to develop new analysis tools and/or modify existing tools.

Basic understanding of test plans and Detailed Methods Of Test for all weapons systems undergoing initial integration or regression testing on the F/A-18 aircraft.

Able to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.

Possess high moral character and integrity.

jobs.description:
Job Description

GIS Technician I

Launch Your GIS Career with Pape-Dawson

Are you passionate about geospatial technology and eager to build your career with an industry-leading engineering and consulting firm? At Pape-Dawson, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced professionals on projects that help shape communities across the country. As a GIS Technician I, you'll gain hands-on experience with the latest GIS technologies while supporting impactful engineering, planning, environmental, and infrastructure projects.

Whether you're just beginning your GIS career or looking to grow your technical skills, you'll find a collaborative environment that encourages learning, mentorship, and professional development.

What You'll Do

Role

As a GIS Technician I, you'll support the development and maintenance of geospatial data, maps, and reporting products while working under the guidance of experienced GIS professionals. In this role, you will:

Create GIS data layers, maps, tables, reports, and other spatial deliverables using ESRI's ArcGIS suite and related applications.
Prepare, edit, and maintain geospatial datasets in accordance with project standards and quality requirements.
Collect, verify, organize, and manage spatial data from a variety of internal and external sources.
Perform basic spatial analysis and data updates using established GIS workflows and methodologies.
Support engineering, planning, and environmental teams by producing accurate mapping products and visualizations.
Collaborate with senior GIS staff while continuing to develop your technical knowledge and GIS best practices.
Contribute to a team culture focused on quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

Associate degree in Geographic Information Systems or a related field (ESRI certification may be substituted for a degree).
Basic proficiency with ESRI ArcGIS software and related GIS applications.
Familiarity with surveys, legal descriptions, construction plans, aerial imagery, and orthophotography.
Understanding of cartographic principles, coordinate systems, map projections, scales, and spatial data management.
Ability to create clear, accurate maps and other geospatial deliverables.
Basic understanding of programming concepts and technical documentation.
Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment while managing multiple priorities.
Ability to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with occasional overtime as project needs require.

Why Join Pape-Dawson?

At Pape-Dawson, we believe our people are our greatest asset. We invest in our employees by providing opportunities to learn, grow, and build rewarding long-term careers. As one of the nation's leading engineering and consulting firms, you'll work on meaningful projects that improve infrastructure and strengthen communities while collaborating with talented professionals who are committed to excellence.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being, including:

Competitive compensation
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company matching
Paid time off and company holidays
Professional development, training, and career advancement opportunities
Collaborative, team-oriented culture with mentorship from experienced professionals
Opportunities to work on innovative, high-impact projects across multiple disciplines

If you're ready to build your GIS career with a company that values innovation, collaboration, and professional growth, we'd love to hear from you.

EEO Statement

All qualified applicants for Pape-Dawson Engineers will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

The Town of Harrisburg is one of the fastest-growing communities in North Carolina and considered one of the top ten affluent zip codes in the surrounding region. While growth has been exponential over the past ten years, the Town has been able to maintain its tight knit community-based mindset and strategically foster a work culture where customer service excellence is our #1 priority.

What We Need

An employee in this class is responsible for the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Town's Geographic Information System (GIS), including enterprise geospatial databases, data integrity, spatial analysis, cartographic production, and GIS application support. Responsibilities include managing and maintaining geospatial datasets; developing maps, data visualizations, and analytical reports; conducting research and spatial analyses to support planning, infrastructure, and operational decision-making; and ensuring the accuracy, accessibility, and reliability of GIS information. The employee provides technical GIS support and expertise to Town departments not limited to Planning, Engineering, Public Works, Stormwater, Parks and Recreation, Code Enforcement, Administration, assists the public with GIS-related requests, and responds to inquiries from external agencies, consultants, and other organizations as appropriate. Work is performed under the general supervision of the Planning Director and is evaluated based on technical proficiency, accuracy, quality of work, effectiveness in meeting departmental objectives, and feedback from Town officials, staff, and the public.

Required Education And Experience

Graduation from a four-year college or university with a major coursework in Geography, Geospatial Science, Planning, Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field and at least 3 to 5 years of professional GIS experience, including data management, spatial analysis, and map production; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Possession of a valid North Carolina driver's license.\

Preferred

Experience working in local government or supporting municipal operations, including planning, engineering, public works, utilities, parks and recreation, or other public sector environments. Familiarity with SQLite data format. GISP certification, Esri technical certifications, or other relevant GIS credentials preferred.

What We Offer

An excellent comprehensive benefits package and a desirable place to work where employees feel appreciated for their contributions.

The hiring range is $67,643 - $84,141 annually and starting salary will be dependent on qualifications and prior experience. Eligible for $2,500 sign-on bonus upon hire.

jobs.title: Radiation Field Scientist, Bureau of Environmental Sciences and Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

Job Description

The Office of Radiological Health (ORH) licenses and inspects more than 7,000 facilities using radioactive materials and x-ray producing equipment throughout New York City to ensure compliance with public health and safety regulations. The program is managed in accordance with statutory authority, delegations from, or agreements with NRC, FDA, and NY State The Bureau of Environmental Sciences and Engineering (ESE) is looking to hire a Scientist Level II for the Office of Radiological Health (ORH). The candidate will inspect medical and research facilities that use radiation producing equipment, assess compliance with New York City Health Code and other applicable regulations, and ensure the safety of patients, staff and the public. This position plays a critical role in protecting public health by ensuring that facilities are properly registered and are implementing policies and procedures that reduce unnecessary exposure to ionizing radiation.

Duties Will Include But Not Be Limited To

Schedule and inspect facilities that use radiation-producing equipment throughout New York City for compliance with NYC Health Code and applicable State and Federal regulations.
Perform on-site tests of radiation-producing equipment installations.
Review and verify facility license and registration information and evaluate quality control procedures.
Prepare reports of inspection using agency protocols, forms and tools.
Prepare and serve court summons and tribunal hearing notices when specific violations of applicable City, State and Federal laws and regulations are found, and appear before tribunal to testify when necessary.
Participate in emergency training exercises and drills and assist in emergency response.
Operating a motor vehicle to perform job duties.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of applicable federal, state and local regulations, standards, and protocols pertaining to radiation safety and control, including New York City Health Code Article 175.
Ability to read, comprehend and interpret written materials such as laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
Ability to interpret radiological measurements and survey results.
Knowledge of radiation safety, dosimetry, and radiation protection principles.
Knowledge of radiation detection instruments and equipment.
Ability to read and interpret data from meters and other measuring devices.
Ability to prepare and interpret data presented in graphs, tables, charts and narrative formats.
Ability to accurately document inspections and evaluations.
Ability to recognize unsafe or inadequate conditions and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to think critically and solve problems.
Excellent organizational and time management skills

Why You Should Work For Us

Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education's website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:
a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position's associated union/benefit fund.
a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
a tax-deferred savings program and
a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.
Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

jobs.title: Senior Research Data Analyst
jobs.description:
The Cystic Fibrosis Foundation
is a leading healthcare nonprofit organization like no other. For decades, we have been taking major steps and pioneering new ways to advance the mission to find a cure for cystic fibrosis and to provide all people with CF the opportunity to lead long, fulfilling lives by funding research and drug development, partnering with the CF community, and advancing high-quality, specialized care.

By joining the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation
, you will be part of a dedicated team committed to our core values and working towards a cure for cystic fibrosis. We offer a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of those affected by CF. Learn more about why work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation.

Position Summary

The Senior Research Data Analyst independently leads various types of data projects and tasks involving clinical data from the CF Patient Registry and other sources and provides analytical support for clinical research. The CF Foundation Patient Registry (CFFPR) is at the core of our care model. Over the last several decades, the Registry has allowed for significant improvements in the lives of people with CF, advancing care and informing research for the development of new treatments, including Transmembrane Conductance Regulator modulators (CFTR).

The Sr. Research Data Analyst engages in all stages of research projects from design and analysis to dissemination and works closely with experts across the spectrum of CF-related disease, which includes pulmonology, transplantation, and other clinical specialties. Specific responsibilities include independent design of research studies and methodologies; design and development of queries, statistical analyses, and analytical reports; collaboration with investigators to validate, troubleshoot, and interpret results; active participation in discussions about the CF Registry and the Registry data. The Sr. Research Data Analyst is also responsible for collaborating directly with our industry partners to design and execute regulatory data studies. Additionally, the Sr. Research Data Analyst supports the design and deployment of the next generation of the CF Foundation Patient Registry by implementing complex queries and analyses with an ultimate goal to enhance the impact of the data collected at the Registry. The Sr. Research Data Analyst also implements analyses to advance projects that address high priority research questions of interest to CFF and the broader CF community.

This is a hybrid role based in Bethesda, MD, and requires 2-3 days per week in the Bethesda office.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Conduct statistical analysis and complex queries for Foundation research projects.
Prepare reports for industry to submit to regulatory agencies to meet their mandated Post-Marking Requirements for approved therapies.
Support research-focused harmonization and integration of CFFPR data with other sources (e.g., international CF registries, administrative data sets).
Collaborate with the CFF Registry team, registry committee members and other CF community stakeholders on study design and data analysis.
Prepare conference submissions and contribute to peer-review manuscript development.
Fulfill analysis requests for data queries for external and internal stakeholders.
Support analysis to evaluate data quality and produce standard reporting outputs, including annual data reports.

Qualifications

Master's in Public Health, Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Applied Mathematics, or Bioinformatics.
Six or more years of experience designing, developing, implementing analyses of public health, clinical or other similar data sources using SAS (required). Familiarity with SQL, R or Python programming is recommended.
Experience with data visualization.
Strong analytic, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis results to lay audiences.
Ability to work collaboratively as part of the registry team.
Experience with the analysis of medical data and terminology.

Reporting Relationships

This position reports to the Sr. Biostatistician.
There will be no supervisory responsibilities.

Working Conditions

Normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, and temperature.
No heavy lifting required.
Minimal travel (e.g., 4x/yr.) to conferences and meetings, as necessary.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities or requirements.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 5 days or until the position is filled. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, so candidates are encouraged to apply promptly if interested.

The salary range is $94,200.00 to $117,600.00. Specific salary varies based on geographic location and is commensurate with experience.

Total Rewards:
The CF Foundation is committed to offering competitive compensation (base pay and incentive), benefits, time off and professional development opportunities that maximize our ability to recruit, retain, reward, and motivate a highly qualified and diverse workforce. Visit our Why Work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation for detailed total rewards information.

The CF Foundation is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to being an employer of choice, not just a good place to work, but a great and inclusive place to work. Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell is expanding its global Test Solutions Engineering (TSE) organization and seeking an experienced Manager to establish, staff, and lead a new TSE team in the Santa Clara US region.

The TSE organization owns ATE based production test development and plays a critical role in optimizing cost, quality, and NPI execution for Marvell’s custom data center silicon. new_jobs.title: Staff Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

Great decisions aren't built on intuition alone – they're built on data.

As a Staff Data Analyst
, you'll partner with teams across the organization to transform data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions. You'll help leaders understand business performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and measure the impact of strategic initiatives.

The best analysts don't just report what happened – they help teams understand why it happened and what to do next. That's the kind of impact we're looking for in this role.

Some of the Problems You'll Solve:

🧪 Which initiatives create the greatest impact?

Design and analyze experiments, pilots, and performance evaluations that separate signal from noise and support confident decision-making.

📈 How healthy is the business?

Build dashboards and reporting that provide leaders with visibility into operational performance, customer outcomes, and organizational health.

🔍 What trends should we be paying attention to?

Analyze data across multiple sources to identify patterns, emerging opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

👥 What behaviors drive successful outcomes?

Use segmentation, cohort analysis, and behavioral data to understand customers, users, or operational processes and identify opportunities to improve results.

🤝 How can data guide better decisions?

Partner with stakeholders across departments to answer high-impact business questions, evaluate tradeoffs, and provide analytical recommendations.

🎯 What should we be measuring that we aren't today?

Improve data quality, instrumentation, and reporting by identifying gaps in existing data collection and helping teams capture the information needed to make informed decisions.

How You'll Make an Impact:

📊 Build confidence in business decisions by designing analyses and communicating insights that help teams understand what is working – and what isn't.

📈 Turn data into strategic direction by uncovering trends, identifying opportunities, and providing actionable recommendations.

📉 Create visibility into organizational performance through dashboards, reporting, and metrics that stakeholders rely on every day.

🤝 Partner with cross-functional teams to frame business problems, evaluate options, and ensure decisions are supported by data.

🎯 Develop meaningful metrics and reporting frameworks that enable teams to consistently measure success and track progress over time.

🔍 Identify opportunities to improve business processes, customer experiences, and operational efficiency through thoughtful analysis.

🧩 Bring clarity to complex problems by asking the right questions, exploring the data, and delivering insights that move the business forward.

You'll Probably Thrive Here If You:

🧩 Use data to drive decisions.

You have a track record of solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and influencing decisions with data.

📊 Have strong analytical fundamentals.

SQL is a core part of your toolkit, and you're comfortable working with large datasets to uncover meaningful insights.

📈 Think beyond reporting.

You don't just build dashboards – you investigate root causes, identify opportunities, and recommend actions.

💬 Communicate with clarity.

You can explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences and help stakeholders make informed decisions.

🤝 Enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

You're comfortable starting with a business question—not a predefined report—and determining what data, analyses, or metrics are needed to answer it.

🔄 Adapt quickly to new tools and technologies.

You enjoy learning new platforms and approaches and focus on solving problems rather than relying on a specific technology stack.

🛠 Bring experience with modern analytics tools.

Experience with SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or similar analytics platforms is a plus, but not required. Great analysts learn new tools. Great critical thinking is harder to teach.

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

Knowledge of radiation detection instruments and equipment.

new_jobs.title: Senior Research Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Cystic Fibrosis Foundation
is a leading healthcare nonprofit organization like no other. For decades, we have been taking major steps and pioneering new ways to advance the mission to find a cure for cystic fibrosis and to provide all people with CF the opportunity to lead long, fulfilling lives by funding research and drug development, partnering with the CF community, and advancing high-quality, specialized care.

By joining the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation
, you will be part of a dedicated team committed to our core values and working towards a cure for cystic fibrosis. We offer a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of those affected by CF. Learn more about why work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation.

Position Summary

The Senior Research Data Analyst independently leads various types of data projects and tasks involving clinical data from the CF Patient Registry and other sources and provides analytical support for clinical research. The CF Foundation Patient Registry (CFFPR) is at the core of our care model. Over the last several decades, the Registry has allowed for significant improvements in the lives of people with CF, advancing care and informing research for the development of new treatments, including Transmembrane Conductance Regulator modulators (CFTR).

The Sr. Research Data Analyst engages in all stages of research projects from design and analysis to dissemination and works closely with experts across the spectrum of CF-related disease, which includes pulmonology, transplantation, and other clinical specialties. Specific responsibilities include independent design of research studies and methodologies; design and development of queries, statistical analyses, and analytical reports; collaboration with investigators to validate, troubleshoot, and interpret results; active participation in discussions about the CF Registry and the Registry data. The Sr. Research Data Analyst is also responsible for collaborating directly with our industry partners to design and execute regulatory data studies. Additionally, the Sr. Research Data Analyst supports the design and deployment of the next generation of the CF Foundation Patient Registry by implementing complex queries and analyses with an ultimate goal to enhance the impact of the data collected at the Registry. The Sr. Research Data Analyst also implements analyses to advance projects that address high priority research questions of interest to CFF and the broader CF community.

This is a hybrid role based in Bethesda, MD, and requires 2-3 days per week in the Bethesda office.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Conduct statistical analysis and complex queries for Foundation research projects.
Prepare reports for industry to submit to regulatory agencies to meet their mandated Post-Marking Requirements for approved therapies.
Support research-focused harmonization and integration of CFFPR data with other sources (e.g., international CF registries, administrative data sets).
Collaborate with the CFF Registry team, registry committee members and other CF community stakeholders on study design and data analysis.
Prepare conference submissions and contribute to peer-review manuscript development.
Fulfill analysis requests for data queries for external and internal stakeholders.
Support analysis to evaluate data quality and produce standard reporting outputs, including annual data reports.

Qualifications

Master's in Public Health, Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Applied Mathematics, or Bioinformatics.
Six or more years of experience designing, developing, implementing analyses of public health, clinical or other similar data sources using SAS (required). Familiarity with SQL, R or Python programming is recommended.
Experience with data visualization.
Strong analytic, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Excellent written and oral communication skills.
Ability to communicate complex analysis results to lay audiences.
Ability to work collaboratively as part of the registry team.
Experience with the analysis of medical data and terminology.

Reporting Relationships

This position reports to the Sr. Biostatistician.
There will be no supervisory responsibilities.

Working Conditions

Normal office environment with little exposure to excessive noise, dust, and temperature.
No heavy lifting required.
Minimal travel (e.g., 4x/yr.) to conferences and meetings, as necessary.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities or requirements.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 5 days or until the position is filled. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, so candidates are encouraged to apply promptly if interested.

The salary range is $94,200.00 to $117,600.00. Specific salary varies based on geographic location and is commensurate with experience.

Total Rewards:
The CF Foundation is committed to offering competitive compensation (base pay and incentive), benefits, time off and professional development opportunities that maximize our ability to recruit, retain, reward, and motivate a highly qualified and diverse workforce. Visit our Why Work at the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation for detailed total rewards information.

Position Overview

The Senior Finance Data Analyst will help lead the development and delivery of advanced analytics that enable stronger financial and commercial decision‑making across Encore. This role plays a critical part in transforming complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights through compelling analysis, visualization, and data storytelling. The Senior Finance Data Analyst will partner closely with Finance, Sales, and Operations to identify trends, surface opportunities, and influence strategy. Success in this role requires not only strong technical expertise, but also the ability to translate data into narratives that resonate with business leaders and drive informed action. This position reports to the Analytics Manager.

Key Job Responsibilities

Assist with the evolution of reporting, analytics, and visualization tools to facilitate strategic decision making.
Design and deliver dashboards and reports that emphasize insight, context, and storytelling, supporting executive‑level and operational audiences.
Extract, interpret, and synthesize data from centralized data sources using advanced SQL queries and structured analytical techniques.
Lead the development, automation, and maintenance of critical financial reports and dashboards, utilizing analytics to drive meaningful actions.
Generate both standardized and ad-hoc reports, providing insightful analyses to support informed financial and operational decisions.
Address data inquiries from diverse business units, offering comprehensive and analytics-driven responses.
Partner on the development, automation, and maintenance of regularly used reports.
Provide keen insights into variances between actual and projected results across the sales organization, enabling strategic adjustments.

Job Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience.
5+ years of related work experience.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and Excel; experience working with large, complex datasets.
Effective quant and analytical abilities, strong bias towards data and insights driven decision-making
Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), with an emphasis on insight driven dashboard design
Familiarity with modern data platforms and architectures; experience with Microsoft Fabric is a plus.
Experience ensuring data quality and integrity through effective data governance processes.
Proven track record of translating complex data into meaningful insights to drive business decisions.
Impeccable organizational acumen, attention to detail, and adeptness at multitasking.
Exceptional problem-solving capabilities paired with outstanding analytical skills.
